questions.question: In fiscal year 2022, how much total revenue from federal sources did California public elementary-secondary school systems receive, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='1', header=None)
cal_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('California', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
result = int(df.iloc[cal_row, 3])

questions.question: How many states and the District of Columbia reported more than 10,000,000 thousand dollars in total elementary-secondary school system debt outstanding at the end of fiscal year 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='10', header=None)
data_rows = df.iloc[11:72].dropna(subset=[0])
data_rows = data_rows[~data_rows[0].astype(str).str.contains('United States|Note|SOURCE', case=False)]
debt_col = pd.to_numeric(data_rows[2], errors='coerce')
result = int((debt_col > 10000000).sum())
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='10', header=None)
# States and DC are rows between United States and the footnotes
# Row for United States
us_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('United States', na=False)].index[0]
# Filter rows with state names
state_rows = df.iloc[us_idx+1:].dropna(subset=[0])
state_rows = state_rows[state_rows[0].astype(str).str.contains('\.{3,}', na=False)]
# Total debt is in col C (index 2)
debt_series = pd.to_numeric(state_rows[2], errors='coerce')
result = int((debt_series > 10000000).sum())

questions.question: In fiscal year 2022, what was the combined general administration support services expenditure for Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='7', header=None)
states = ['Connecticut', 'Maine', 'Massachusetts', 'New Hampshire', 'Rhode Island', 'Vermont']
pattern = '|'.join(states)
matched = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, na=False)]
result = int(pd.to_numeric(matched[5], errors='coerce').sum())

questions.question: What was the average per pupil current spending on instruction across California, Oregon, and Washington in fiscal year 2022, in dollars rounded to two decimal places?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='8', header=None)
states = ['California', 'Oregon', 'Washington']
pattern = '|'.join(states)
matched = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, na=False)]
vals = pd.to_numeric(matched[5], errors='coerce')
result = round(float(vals.mean()), 2)

questions.question: In fiscal year 2022, did Texas public elementary-secondary school systems issue more long-term debt than California public school systems?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='10', header=None)
tx_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Texas', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
ca_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('California', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
tx_debt = float(df.iloc[tx_row, 5])
ca_debt = float(df.iloc[ca_row, 5])
result = 'yes' if tx_debt > ca_debt else 'no'

questions.question: For Vermont public school systems in fiscal year 2022, which major revenue source—Federal sources, State sources, or Local sources—provided the largest percentage of total funding?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_school_system_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='5', header=None)
vt_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Vermont', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
shares = {
    str(df.iloc[5, 3]): float(df.iloc[vt_row, 3]),
    str(df.iloc[5, 5]): float(df.iloc[vt_row, 5]),
    str(df.iloc[5, 7]): float(df.iloc[vt_row, 7]),
}
result = max(shares, key=shares.get)
